tools.name: list_processings
tools.description: List the processings of the active account: periodic or on-demand tasks that run a plugin to ingest, transform or publish datasets. Each result tells its plugin, whether it is active, its last run and next scheduled run, and the profile of the caller on it (admin, exec or read). Use describe_processing for one processing.

q.description: Full text search on the titles.

statuses.description: Statuses of the last run, comma separated: triggered, scheduled, running, error, finished, kill, killed.

response_format.description: concise: _id, title, plugin, active, lastRun, nextRun, userProfile. detailed: every field.

tools.name: create_processing
tools.description: Create a processing of a plugin. The plugin id is the _id of a processing artefact found with registry_search_artefacts (category processing). The owner defaults to the active account. The processing is created inactive and without config: fill the config next with the processing_config tools, then activate it with update_processing.

plugin.description: Registry artefact id of the plugin (e.g. @data-fair-processing-hello-world-1).

tools.name: describe_processing
tools.description: Read a processing: its plugin, scheduling, activation, last and next runs. Its config and permissions are included when the caller is an admin of the processing.

tools.name: delete_processing
tools.description: Delete a processing permanently, its runs are deleted too. The datasets it published stay.

tools.name: update_processing
tools.description: Rename a processing, activate or deactivate it, or replace its scheduling. A processing needs a valid config to be activated. The scheduling is the whole list of its schedules, an empty list for on-demand runs only. Use the processing_config tools for its config.

tools.name: update_processing_permissions
tools.description: Replace the whole permissions list of a processing, which gives other users or partner organizations a read or exec profile on it, or give the processing to another owner. Read the current permissions first with describe_processing: the list sent replaces them all.

x-i18n-title.en: Read - gives access to the essential information of the processing, logs included, but not to the sensitive information
x-i18n-title.fr: Lecture - permet d'accéder aux informations essentielles du traitement dont les logs, mais pas aux informations sensibles

x-i18n-title.en: Execution - gives access to the essential information of the processing and allows to trigger it
x-i18n-title.fr: Exécution - permet d'accéder aux informations essentielles du traitement et de déclencher le traitement

tools.name: list_runs
tools.description: List the runs of the processings of the active account, most recent first, without their logs. Each run tells its status (triggered, scheduled, running, error, finished, kill, killed) and its dates. Use describe_run for the log of one run.

processing.description: The _id of the processing whose runs are listed.

response_format.description: concise: _id, status, createdAt, startedAt, finishedAt, processing. detailed: every field.

tools.name: describe_run
tools.description: Read a run with its log: the steps, infos, warnings and errors the plugin wrote. The tool to explain why a run failed. The log may quote data of external sources.

tools.name: trigger_processing
tools.description: Run a processing now, or after a delay, out of its scheduling. The processing must be active (an error 409 otherwise). Follow the run with list_runs and describe_run.

delay.description: Delay before the run starts, in seconds.

tools.name: kill_run
tools.description: Stop a running run: its status becomes kill until the worker stops it (killed). The work done by the plugin so far is not rolled back.

tools.name: processing_config_getData
tools.description: Get the current "Processing config" data and validity status. The data is always returned whole and unmodified, so on a large form pass "path" to read one part of it rather than the entire document.

path.description: Node path as returned by describeState (e.g. "/address/city"). Omit for the whole document.

tools.name: processing_config_setData
tools.description: Write several "Processing config" fields at once: the given keys are merged into the current data, nested objects included; arrays you pass replace the existing ones. Prefer setFieldValue to change one field. Check the errors and warnings in the response.

data.description: The form data object to set

merge.description: Merge the given keys into the existing data, nested objects included (default); arrays you pass replace the existing ones. Set false to replace the whole object, which removes every key you do not pass.

save.description: Save the form after this write, when the write leaves it valid (default false).

tools.name: processing_config_describeState
tools.description: Describe the "Processing config" form: every field with its path, type, constraints, current value and errors. Pass "path" to describe one subtree instead of the whole form; what is too large to describe whole is answered as an outline. Each option of a choice is listed with the fields it brings, and a path to an option not chosen (".../$oneOf/2") or to an item of a list still empty describes what it would hold. To find a field without knowing which tab holds it, pass "query" with words of its name.

path.description: Node path as returned by describeState (e.g. "/address/city"). Omit for the whole tree. It may name what does not exist yet: an option not chosen ("/menu/0/$oneOf/2"), or an item of a list still empty ("/menu/0").

query.description: Words to look for instead of describing: lists the fields (under "path" if given) whose key, title, help or short text value holds all of them, accents and case apart, including those a condition hides.

tools.name: processing_config_setFieldValue
tools.description: Set the value of a specific field of "Processing config" by path. To switch a variant selector, set value to the desired variant index (shown in describeState); the answer then lists the fields of the branch it activated. The returned errors are scoped to the modified field.

path.description: Node path as returned by describeState (e.g. "/address/city").

value.description: The value to set. For variant-selector fields, pass the variant index to switch variants. Exclusive with "suggestionIndex".

suggestionIndex.description: Index from the last getFieldSuggestions call on this same path. Exclusive with "value".

save.description: Save the form after this write, when the write leaves it valid (default false).

tools.name: processing_config_getFieldSuggestions
tools.description: Get the accepted values of a field of "Processing config" that describeState marked "suggestions", optionally filtered by a query. A field whose values describeState already stated on its line as values=[...] needs no call — write one of them. Each option comes back with an index and a title; one whose value is not a short scalar is listed by title alone, exactly as a user sees it. To choose one, call setFieldValue with the same path and "suggestionIndex" set to its index, and the full original value is applied.

path.description: Node path as returned by describeState (e.g. "/address/city").

tools.name: processing_config_editArray
tools.description: Add, remove or move items in an array field of "Processing config". Use describeState to see current array contents. When adding an item it is activated for edition and its children fields are returned, they can then be filled with setFieldValue. The returned errors are scoped to this array. Moving an item keeps its data, so reorder with move rather than adding and removing.

path.description: Node path as returned by describeState (e.g. "/address/city"). Must be an array field.

action.description: "add" to insert an item, "remove" to delete one, "move" to put an item at another place in the list

index.description: Index to insert at (for add, defaults to end) or remove from (for remove, defaults to last)

from.description: Index of the item to move (move only, required)

to.description: Index the item should have afterwards (move only, required)

value.description: Value for the new item (for add action). For an item that is a choice between options, choose its option by the discriminator value describeState lists for it, e.g. { "type": "..." }: "$oneOf" is a path segment, not a data key. Or omit the value and choose the option afterwards with setFieldValue on the item's $oneOf.

save.description: Save the form after this write, when the write leaves it valid (default false).

tools.name: processing_config_saveForm
tools.description: Save the "Processing config" form: persist the data currently in it through the session's save function. Refuses while the form is invalid. On a version conflict, reload first.

tools.name: processing_config_reloadForm
tools.description: Reload the "Processing config" form from its source, discarding local changes. Use it to resolve a save conflict.

skills.name: workflow
skills.description: How to set up and follow processings: find a plugin, create a processing, fill its config, schedule and activate it, trigger it, then follow its runs and diagnose a failed one from its log. Read it before creating or repairing a processing.

skills.name: processing-config
skills.description: Processing config: how to use the processing_config_* form tools.
